name: tab-state-mcp
description: Answers questions about your Chrome tab reading history from the Tab State extension.
long_description: Tab State tracks how you actually use your Chrome tabs (active reading time, scroll depth, copies/highlights) and sorts them into Just Glanced / Partially Read / Deep Focus / Ghost. This extension exposes that local history to Claude Desktop: ask things like "what was I reading about X last week" or "summarize my browsing session." Requires the Tab State Chrome extension (github.com/asyau/tab-state) with MCP sync turned on in its Settings page. Runs entirely on your machine and never sends data anywhere else.

port.title: Sync port
port.description: Local port the Tab State Chrome extension posts your tracked tabs to. Must match the port set in the extension's Settings → MCP server panel (default 8765 on both sides).
